title: Ring attractor networks go full circle
title_zh: 环吸引子网络全圆运行
abstract: Clark et al. demonstrate that heterogeneous data-driven models implement head-direction selectivity through the same dynamical principles as classical ring networks. In doing so, the authors reconcile biological realism with theoretical simplicity, unifying existing frameworks and broadening the space of connectivity structures to be searched in data.
abstract_zh: Clark 等人展示，异质数据驱动模型通过与经典环网络相同的动力学原理实现头向选择性。在此过程中，作者将生物现实主义与理论简洁性相结合，统一了现有框架，并拓宽了在数据中搜索的连接结构空间。
